options.name: --n-cpu-moe
options.description:
MoE CPU/GPU expert offload (llama.cpp
--n-cpu-moe equivalent): put the routed
experts of the first N layers on the
CPU, trading throughput for device
memory. Vulkan Qwen3MoeHybrid (#370):
CPU expert compute for those layers.
CUDA nemotron_h_moe (#1071): those
layers' experts are never cached and
always computed on the CPU. Unset =
none (env fallback DOTLLM_N_CPU_MOE).
No-op on the cpu backend

options.name: --moe-offload
options.description:
Routed-MoE expert placement on CUDA
(nemotron_h_moe): 'auto' (default: keep
experts in VRAM when the model fits,
else offload them to a host store with
a VRAM expert cache), 'off' (refuse a
model that does not fit), 'on' (always
offload). Env fallback:
DOTLLM_MOE_OFFLOAD

options.name: --moe-cache-mib
options.description:
VRAM expert-cache size in MiB when
the measured free-VRAM budget. Larger
values are clamped to the budget. Env
fallback: DOTLLM_MOE_CACHE_MIB
(default), 'lru' or 'lfu'. Env
fallback: DOTLLM_MOE_CACHE_POLICY
the VRAM cache run: 'auto' (default:
per expert, CPU or copy-to-GPU by a
cost model calibrated at load), 'copy'
(compute every uncached expert on the
CPU; an expert enters the cache only
when its recent use beats the weakest
cached one). Env fallback:
DOTLLM_MOE_COLD
on the CPU (one expert per worker);
default physical cores - 1. Env
fallback: DOTLLM_MOE_CPU_THREADS

options.name: --moe-cache-policy
options.description:
Expert-cache replacement policy: 'slru'
(default), 'lru' or 'lfu'. Env
fallback: DOTLLM_MOE_CACHE_POLICY

options.name: --moe-cold
options.description:
Where offloaded experts that are not in
the VRAM cache run: 'auto' (default:
per expert, CPU or copy-to-GPU by a
cost model calibrated at load), 'copy'
(copy every miss into the cache), 'cpu'
(compute every uncached expert on the
CPU; an expert enters the cache only
when its recent use beats the weakest
cached one). Env fallback:
DOTLLM_MOE_COLD

options.name: --moe-cpu-threads
options.description:
Worker threads for MoE experts computed
on the CPU (one expert per worker);
default physical cores - 1. Env
fallback: DOTLLM_MOE_CPU_THREADS

options.name: --cpu-moe
options.description:
Keep every MoE layer's routed experts
on the CPU (llama.cpp --cpu-moe). CUDA
nemotron_h_moe: never cached, always
computed on the CPU; Vulkan
Qwen3MoeHybrid (bench): as --n-cpu-moe
with every layer. Env fallback:
DOTLLM_CPU_MOE=1

options.name: --moe-calibrate
options.description:
Re-run the MoE offload cost calibration
(PCIe bandwidth, sync latency, CPU time
per expert) instead of reading the
cached record in
%LOCALAPPDATA%/dotllm/moe-calibration.j
son. Env fallback:
DOTLLM_MOE_CALIBRATE=1

options.name: --ctx-size
options.description:
Context window in tokens (llama.cpp
-c). For nemotron_h_moe it caps the
model's context and is what the MoE
expert-offload VRAM budget reserves KV
cache for (default: the model's maximum
context, e.g. 262144 for Nemotron 3.5
Bolt). Lower it to leave more VRAM for
the expert cache. Env fallback:
DOTLLM_MOE_CTX

options.name: --depth-list
options.description:
Comma-separated context depths for
multi-point sweep (e.g.,
512,2048,8192). Measures decode at each
checkpoint in one process without
reloading the model. Mutually exclusive
with --depth

options.name: --warmup
options.description:
Number of warm-up repetitions to
discard per checkpoint (default: 1).
Use 0 to skip warm-up entirely

arguments.name: MODEL
arguments.description:
Path to a GGUF file or HuggingFace repo ID (e.g.,
QuantFactory/SmolLM-135M-GGUF)

commands.name: perplexity
commands.description: Compute perplexity over a text corpus.

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --version
options.description: Prints version information

options.name: --corpus
options.description:
Path to a UTF-8 text
corpus (e.g.
wiki.test.raw)

options.name: --normalize-line-endings
options.description:
Collapse CRLF to LF while
reading --corpus, as MSVC
text mode does. OFF by
default. Use ONLY when the
reference figure came from
a Windows llama.cpp build
reading the same CRLF
file; llama.cpp on Linux
keeps the CRs, so
normalizing there creates
a mismatch. Preferred fix
is an LF corpus (see
docs/PERPLEXITY.md, issue
#506)

options.name: --context
options.description:
512               Context window in tokens.
Clamped to the model's
maximum sequence length

options.name: --stride
options.description:
0                 Tokens advanced between
window starts. 0 selects
the context length
(non-overlapping chunks,
llama.cpp's default)

options.name: --unscored-prefix
options.description:
Leading tokens of each
window used as context
only. -1 selects context/2
(llama.cpp's default)

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description:
0                 Cap on corpus tokens
consumed. 0 = unbounded

options.name: --mode
options.description:
sliding-window    Scoring mode:
sliding-window (default,
llama.cpp-comparable) or
teacher-forced

options.name: --tokens-file
options.description:
Read pre-tokenized
whitespace-separated ids
instead of tokenizing
--corpus. Isolates scoring
from tokenization when
comparing against another
implementation
ids to this path,
continue. Diagnostic

options.name: --dump-tokens
options.description:
Write the tokenized corpus
ids to this path,
whitespace-separated, then
continue. Diagnostic

options.name: --per-window
options.description:
Print each window's
perplexity. Use to
localize a disagreement
with another
implementation to specific
corpus content

options.name: --bos
options.description:
Prepend BOS to the stream
and substitute it at each
window start. Defaults to
